inputs.description: A federated BIM Open Schema DuckDB file whose document titles carry DigitalHub's discipline codes (FM-ARC, FM-HZG, FM-LFT, FM-SAN).
inputs.name: model

about.text: How many placed elements each of DigitalHub's four discipline models contributes to the federated file. models counts the elements on a storey per source document and takes the discipline code from the document's title (DigitalHub_FM-ARC_v2 gives ARC); disciplines spells each German code out: ARC architecture, HZG heating (Heizung), LFT ventilation (Lüftung), SAN plumbing (Sanitär).

answer.title: Elements on a storey, per discipline model

models.sql: SELECT regexp_extract(d.Strings, 'FM-([A-Z]+)', 1) AS Code, d.Strings AS Model, count(*) AS Elements, count(DISTINCT s.StoreyIndex) AS Storeys FROM StoreyOfElement s JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = s.EntityIndex JOIN Documents doc ON doc.rowid = e.Document JOIN Strings d ON d.rowid = doc.Title GROUP BY d.Strings ORDER BY d.Strings
